partners.name: Sama Owj Middle East Travel Agency
partners.description: Sama Owj Middle East is a Tehran-based travel agency providing domestic and international tours, flight ticketing, hotel reservations and tourist visa services. Its work emphasizes experienced travel professionals, modern technology and quality customer service.
partners.address: No. 177, Jordan Street, 1st Floor, Unit 102, Tehran, Iran
about: Sama Owj Middle East is a Tehran-based travel agency and strategic affiliate of NovaNest Holding, bringing together expertise in tourism, travel management, and international experiences to support entrepreneurship, investment, and business development. Through this collaboration, NovaNest and Sama Owj Middle East aim to create new opportunities at the intersection of tourism, education, and entrepreneurship, with a particular focus on supporting tourism-related startups, developing business concepts, and connecting entrepreneurs with relevant markets, industry professionals, and potential partners.

As part of this partnership, Sama Owj Middle East collaborates with NovaNest’s incubation, acceleration, and investment initiatives by contributing tourism industry expertise, supporting the development and evaluation of tourism-focused business ventures, and helping organize educational programs, professional workshops, business events, conferences, and international networking opportunities. The partnership also aims to facilitate participation in global business exhibitions, investment forums, entrepreneurship conferences, and industry events, enabling entrepreneurs and startups to gain international exposure, explore new markets, build valuable connections, and identify potential investment and collaboration opportunities.

By combining Sama Owj Middle East’s travel industry capabilities with NovaNest’s entrepreneurial ecosystem, business development expertise, and investment-oriented approach, the partnership seeks to transform travel and international engagement into practical opportunities for learning, growth, and business expansion. Together, the two organizations aim to develop initiatives such as educational and business travel programs, international learning experiences, tourism entrepreneurship projects, and cross-border business networking activities that help emerging entrepreneurs and startups access broader opportunities and build sustainable businesses.
services: Hotel reservations in Iran and abroad

partners.name: Gohar Afarinan Farda — Gold & Jewelry
partners.description: Gohar Afarinan Farda is an Iranian company specializing in gold and jewelry services, consulting, training, and innovation. As a NovaNest affiliate, it helps gold-industry entrepreneurs explore opportunities to expand or relocate their businesses abroad, especially to Canada.
about: Gohar Afarinan Farda is an Iranian company specializing in gold and jewelry services, consulting, training, and innovation, with more than 20 years of industry experience. Supported by a team of over 30 specialists, more than 50 successful projects, over 1,000 satisfied clients, and eight branches across Iran, the company brings extensive industry knowledge and practical expertise to the gold and jewelry sector. Through its network of trusted partner brands, including 18 Ayar, Baharan, Goharan, Nabat, Romis, and Sororian, the company is actively involved in various aspects of the industry, including design, production, product development, marketing, and distribution.

As a strategic affiliate of NovaNest Holding, Gohar Afarinan Farda helps connect gold and jewelry entrepreneurs with opportunities for international business development, expansion, and market entry, particularly in Canada. Through this collaboration, the two organizations support entrepreneurs seeking to establish or expand their gold and jewelry businesses in the Canadian market by helping them explore business opportunities, develop their business concepts, understand market requirements, and identify potential partnerships. The partnership also creates opportunities to exchange industry knowledge, deliver specialized training, and explore new business models that combine traditional expertise with modern entrepreneurial approaches.

By combining Gohar Afarinan Farda’s extensive gold and jewelry industry experience and professional network with NovaNest’s expertise in entrepreneurship, business development, incubation, acceleration, and investment, the partnership aims to help industry professionals turn their experience and business ambitions into sustainable international ventures. Together, the organizations seek to facilitate cross-border business development, support the international growth of gold and jewelry businesses, and help entrepreneurs navigate the opportunities and challenges of establishing a presence in Canada.
services: Professional training and education for gold-industry businesses
